name: reduce_drop_last
summary: CONTROL for reduce_sum: every entrant sums only x[0..n-2], skipping the last element; judged by the reduce_sum reference and bound, it must fail
provenance: authored for OpenAccel Lab (Apache-2.0); deliberately wrong copy of workloads/reduce_sum

y.why: reduce_sum's contract. Inputs lie in [0.5, 1), so the bound gamma(n)*sum|x_i| < gamma(n)*n while the dropped element is >= 0.5 and the summation error is far below it: WolframLanguageEvaluator: u=2^-24; g[n_]:=n u/(1-n u); N[g[2003]*2003,10] -> 0.2391629245; N[g[257]*257,10] -> 0.003936887490; n = 1 drops the only element (y = 0 against x[0] >= 0.5). At reduce_sum's n = 100003 a single element of [-1, 1] sits under the bound (N[g[100003]*100003/2,10] -> 299.8282749), so the control uses n = 2003.
